nodes.label: 01-02-PLAN.md
nodes.community_name: Plan 01-02: Guard Verdict UX & Ticket Invalidation Integration

truths: Guard screen displays a responsive full-screen verdict overlay on scan outcome.
ALLOW verdict displays large checkmark and student details, auto-dismissing after 2 seconds; late returns show amber LATE RETURN badge.
DENY verdict displays large X and plain-language reason, requiring an explicit Dismiss tap (no auto-dismiss).
Scanner stream is debounced so a single physical frame cannot produce duplicate scans, ignoring frames while verdict overlay is active.
A rolling Recent Gate Scans list displays below the scanner with timestamps in IST.

truths: Minimum dwell time is read from AppSetting minDwellMinutes (defaulting to 5 minutes, 0 for testing), removing hardcoded 10-minute constants.
Return scan attempts before dwell expiry trigger a DENY verdict with resultCode MIN_DWELL and live countdown details.
Every early return attempt logs an audit event with guardId, outpassId, and server timestamp for Admin/HOD visibility.
All existing gate verification and token signature checks pass with zero regression.
